title: A Typewriter for the Lantern
author: Sebastian Quintana
blurb: Sebastian Lockridge, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
